# MAT Labs

> MAT Labs Inc. builds Spatial Phase Imaging (SPI), a 3D vision format, and Figure OS. MAT is building the closest thing to a human eye for today's machines. The name MAT comes from the Greek μάτι (máti), meaning eye. The line of the company is Oculi ex Machina — eyes from the machine.

MAT Labs is a business-to-business company. It supplies U.S. enterprises and U.S. government and defense programs. The product is a 3D sensor and a software stack. The sensor captures high-resolution visual and spatial data in real time as Spatial Phase Imaging. Figure OS runs modern vision models on that stream: people detection, pose tracking, high-resolution face and body meshes, pixels on target, and surface texture maps.

## Name

- MAT derives from μάτι (máti), Greek for eye.
- Named for the Latin figura, shape. Figure OS is the software.
- Oculi ex Machina means "eyes from the machine," a play on deus ex machina. In English: Vision ex Machina.

## Markets

- Autonomous cars
- Autonomous drones
- Robots and androids
- Intelligent CCTV
- Smart cities
